snippet.title: The People of Sea, Sun & Salt – Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The People of Sea, Sun & Salt launches on April 1.

Build a thriving civilization on a small Mediterranean island. Define your culture, manage resources, and guide your people through changing eras while facing the forces of nature.

Will your city flourish… or collapse into the sea?

Wishlist the game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617200/The_people_of_Sea_Sun__Salt/

Features:
• Build and expand a unique island civilization
• Define the beliefs and culture of your people
• Manage resources and growing city needs
• Progress through multiple eras
• Discover secrets hidden beneath the sea
